term: ability to bring good from evils collectively
definition: CanDrawGoodFromEvils g evils means g is capable of bringing some good from the evils picked out by evils considered together. This is a primitive capability predicate, not an actual GoodIn witness or a modal possibility of an already existing perfection; no accessibility relation or general modal logic is stipulated.
note: Parameter semantics for explicit scope comparison, motivated by the pinned ad 1 wording. A source argument fixing the relation extension or connecting the collective and distributive relations would be needed to go beyond this interpretation; no such bridge is supplied here.
